name: Camp Hochelaga
description_short: YWCA Vermont's inclusive girls+ camp in South Hero. It offers one-week overnight sessions (Sunday to Friday) plus a two-week session, weekly day camp with a free bus from Burlington and Milton, a one-week Mini-Camp that mixes day and overnight, and a 5-week Counselor in Training program. Tuition has three tiers, and the lower two are open to everyone.
activities: Daily activity choices for day campers, such as basketball and paper puppets
Day camp sleepovers (one night per session)
Changeover weekend trips: state park hikes, museums, indoor rock climbing, drive-in movies
special_needs_notes: Not a specialized medical or therapeutic camp, but the team includes a camper mental health specialist, and leaders are trained to work with youth with mental health needs, disabilities and learning disabilities. Families of campers with specific needs are asked to reach out first.

refund_policy_summary: Cancel in writing or by phone at least two weeks before the camper arrives for a refund; less than two weeks before, no refund. The deposit is non-refundable (a Circle of Girls+ scholarship applicant who can no longer accept may get it back). Homesickness is not a reason for a refund.
